objective: Exercise GR_python on a coordinate-nontrivial but physically flat metric.
claim: Minkowski spacetime in spherical coordinates has nonzero connection coefficients but zero Riemann tensor, Ricci tensor and Ricci scalar.
assumptions: Coordinates are restricted to r>0 and 0<theta<pi to avoid spherical-coordinate singularities.
GR_python uses the tensor conventions documented by its public API.
limitations: A zero-curvature reference validates the calculation path but is not a validation of every metric supported by GR_python.
